q: How many hours do I need?
desc: You need 7 hours for the Passport or ID, or 14 hours if you want both!
Anything identity-related! Build something around IDs, authentication, NFC, digital identity, or whatever else you can come up with.

q: Do I need to be good at coding?
desc: Nope! Just give it your best and ship a quality project you're proud of.
Your ID works with Attend, so you can use it to check in at Hack Club events without your phone. BUT BUT BUT it's also a pretty cool keepsake of your time at Hack Club. Doesn't hurt to keep it :D
I'm working on this mostly by myself, and I've got exams too :( Please be patient! Getting the logistics of physical IDs sorted out takes a while.
Double-dipping isn't allowed (yet), but feel free to submit a new project!
